events.title: Anthropy founded
events.description: Founded by Jiansheng Zhang and Bryan Carmichael at UWC South East Asia. International members joined in the years since, though the organization has remained mostly Singapore-based.

events.title: Inaugural leadership year
events.description: Bryan Carmichael serves as founding Editor-in-Chief as the organization establishes its first structure.

events.title: Xiaoyao Lu and Kaitlyn Song lead as Co-Chairs
events.description: Leadership expands into distinct operational roles as the organization grows.

events.title: In2Academia launches
events.description: Julia Piórko Bermig founds and designs In2Academia, and publishes the first two editions of the Anthropy Review.

events.title: Ruhani Surana becomes Chair
events.description: Ruhani Surana, who joined UWCSEA in 2023, takes over as Chair.

events.title: Leadership roles expand
events.description: Dedicated Head of Operations and Head of Marketing roles are added to the team.

events.title: Mysha Shangari and Vaish Krishnaprabhu lead as Co-Chairs
events.description: The current team runs the research programme, the journal, and Humanities Focus.

events.title: The Anthropy Review, 3rd Edition
events.description: Five student papers are published, spanning law, economics, political science, geography, and psychology.

events.title: New leadership team selected
events.description: The next leadership team is chosen for the 2026–2027 year, taking over the research programme, the journal, and Humanities Focus.
